answer: Each agent identity must escrow a bond bigger than the reward it can earn per epoch. A forged key proves nothing about history, so this nebula of clones costs capital, not code: a thousand fakes means fronting a thousand bonds, each slashed to zero on collusion. Cost grows linearly with fleet size while honest agents pay little, and cheap signatures send no real signal of participation. A unique challenge cipher handshake on top makes every clone expensive to mint silently, so the swarm loses money.
